The prompt instructs to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers, treating all audits as fallible. 'Óscar da Imprensa' (C2) is rejected because D1S4 identifies it as the *initial name* of the Prémio Bordalo, not a separate award received. 'several grants and fellowships' (C3) is rejected as they are described as general recognitions rather than a specific named award. 'Razzie' (C4) is rejected as it is an alias for the Golden Raspberry Award, and the full specific name is preferred.
